verdict.rationale: Galileo documents Experiments for evaluating prompts, models and application code against chosen metrics. Nothing in the evidence describes viewing or comparing two or more eval runs side by side, or detecting regressions between prompt or model versions. Running individual experiments is an adjacent capability, not the comparison workflow the story asks for.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can compare eval runs side by side to catch regressions between prompt or model versions
